name: status-band
description: Status band above the Claude Code prompt: prompt-cache countdown, today's cost and plan limits, open PRs and the coord-bus seat

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: auto detects it from the cache's behaviour (assumes 5m until it has seen enough); 5m or 1h forces it

showUsage.title: Show cost and plan limits
showUsage.description: Today's cost across your sessions and the 5h / 7d plan-limit percentages

showPrs.title: Show open PRs
showPrs.description: The number of open PRs in this repo (needs the gh CLI)

showBus.title: Show coord bus row
showBus.description: This seat on the agent-coord bus: id, rooms and unread (hidden when there is no bus)
